known_scope: The asymptotic quantity and arithmetic/support phenomena are known; the exact four-block protocol and any residual after a complete wheel/HL null are not established as a named result.
independent_reproduction_scope: deterministic prime generation and core statistics; not full scientific-null validation
verdict: EXP-0008 reproducibly rejects the operational i.i.d. continuous Exp(1) surrogate, but the result is dominated by finite-scale arithmetic support, dependence, and an inadequate residue-aware null. It does not establish a deviation from the Gallagher/Poisson heuristic or a novel prime-gap law.
effect_size: Against iid Exp(1), histogram total-variation distance is 0.2131, 0.1539, 0.1504, and 0.1450 for B1-B4; empirical-quantile W1 is approximately 0.1630, 0.1343, 0.1144, and 0.1024. The first impossible bin contributes 576022.2 chi-square units, 59.28% of the combined 971920.0236. Mean shifts are only 0.002428, 0.001326, 0.000359, and 0.000081.

primary_statistic.definition: delta_i = (p_{i+1} - p_i) / log(p_i), with p_i the lower prime

dependence_diagnostics.interpretation: The mean conclusion is robust to a basic contiguous-cluster correction; the full distribution and tail p-values are not calibrated against a dependence-aware prime model.

alternative_model_checks.interpretation: These are exploratory, non-preregistered checks. They show that arithmetic conditioning removes much of the first-bin discrepancy but do not identify a complete Gallagher/Hardy-Littlewood null.
